description: This file contains the definition of the SugarSpot class, which is responsible for performing search operations within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for executing searches across multiple modules, formatting search results, and managing search settings and constraints.

classes.name: SugarSpot
classes.description: Handles global search functionalities including performing searches, formatting results, and managing search modules within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and returns an HTML widget with the formatted results, deprecated since version 6.5.

methods.name: formatSearchResultsToDisplay
methods.description: Formats raw search results into displayable results, including handling pagination and search result naming.

methods.name: getSearchFields
methods.description: Loads search field definitions for a given module, checking both default and custom directories.

methods.name: _getCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of search results for a given query and seed object.

methods.name: getSearchModules
methods.description: Determines which modules are available for search, prioritizing user preferences and module visibility.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query across selected modules with optional offset, limit, and options.

methods.name: _performSearch
methods.description: Core method that executes a search across specified modules, constructing queries, and retrieving data.

methods.name: _searchKeys
methods.description: Helper method to identify and prioritize search keys based on patterns and module names.

methods.name: filterSearchType
methods.description: Determines if a field type matches the search query criteria, filtering out incompatible types.
